name: Death
role: Guardian of Hell's gate; son (and, by incest, mate) of Sin; son of Satan
description: Category D, thin biblical seed. Born of Satan's rape of Sin; monstrous, formless, insatiable. Like Sin, the only scriptural anchor is James 1:15's single metaphorical sentence about sin producing death -- the full genealogical horror (Death raping his own mother Sin, producing the hell-hounds that gnaw at her) is wholly Milton's invention. See docs/milton/character-catalog.md §III.
narrative_function: Guards Hell's gate beside Sin; later, in Book X, builds the bridge from Hell to Earth alongside her, formalizing corruption's permanent access to the mortal world.
